scope: Source-only caret, table-chrome and empty-caret drag tracking fixes; optional per-editor application selection accent in source and notebook, resolved in the editor appearance and repainted without document attribute edits. Nil retains upstream selection palettes. No undo or layout-engine replacement. v4 aligns source line numbers to actual TextKit glyph baselines across font and size changes, including trailing empty rows; notebook cap-centering is unchanged. v5 adds read-only code-block margin anchors and slot/palette access for optional host companion actions. Native copy drawing, hover, clipboard, mouse handling and layout remain unchanged. v6 reserves the fixed bullet/checkbox marker width even when the initial host column is zero-width, and renders one visual gap after unordered bullet markers while preserving all source whitespace. No change to the parser, native copy buttons, or layout engine. v7 adds an optional per-editor Markdown paste representation provider after native image/list/cell handling, so a host can consume its own result clipboard text without importing NSTextTable RTF into TextKit 2. Nil preserves upstream paste behavior. v8 adds optional per-editor embedded-view cursor and rectangle providers. Native mouseMoved/cursorUpdate use the host cursor before NSTextView can set its I-beam. The editor cursor rectangles exclude host child regions. Nil providers preserve native behavior; the host resolves child hit testing, cursor types and refresh after native enter/exit and scrolling. No click, drag, selection, text or layout changes. v9 adds optional per-editor source font/paragraph attributes shared by initial source styling, native recompose and typing (nil preserves upstream). Adds opt-in preservation of the clip X origin for vertical navigation (existing default remains). Provides SHA-256-verified bundled Mermaid loading through the existing renderer and resolves compound-class SVG paint for native XY bars/lines. No undo, business execution, WebView rendering or layout-engine replacement. Mermaid fences participate in the existing viewport-anchored content-width restyle so native overlays follow window resizing. v10 avoids restyling the zero-length trailing blank on selection: its preceding newline and extra-line geometry remain untouched. An empty EOF activation updates typing/active state synchronously; old Markdown requiring deactivation retains its styling path. Nonempty endpoints and other selections retain deferred activation. Host source colors are separately finalized in willProcessEditing before layout. v11 derives source line-number chrome from the provisional storage edit during IME, without committing/restyling marked text. Source rows including EOF are enumerated once by logical display offsets; provisional empty-row geometry cannot overlap the preceding row. Marked edits repaint line-number chrome. Notebook geometry and public committed line lookups remain unchanged. v12 clears native margin hover state directly when a host child owns a mouseMoved event. Only a genuine mouseExited event is passed to NSTextView.mouseExited, avoiding AppKit trackingArea assertions. Host cursor precedence, real exit behavior and nil-provider paths are preserved. v13 finalizes the existing bounded viewport/caret layout after editing a Visual fenced block, before caret measurement and painting. Source mode, prose, IME marked edits and full-document layout are unchanged. v14 skips same-block caret-only restyling in an active fenced block: the complete fence source is already revealed, so crossing code rows or either delimiter changes no attributes. Text edits and block activation/deactivation retain their recomposition paths.
